benchmark_metadata.model_architecture: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 reg4 with dino.txt Vision Head and Text Encoder
benchmark_metadata.model_license: DINOv2 code and model weights, including the dino.txt Vision Head and Text Encoder: Apache-2.0; CLIP BPE vocabulary: MIT; OpenVLCLIP software is separately licensed.
benchmark_metadata.model_compatibility_note: Uses OpenVLCLIP v0.6.0's official dino.txt configuration and raw text without a task prefix. The global embedding space is fixed at 2048D; MRL truncation is not supported. Local scientific benchmark use is verified under the pinned DINOv2 Apache-2.0 terms; see docs/dinotxt-license-review.md. Japanese evaluation is exploratory.
benchmark_metadata.dataset_license: Google LLC licenses the XM3600 annotations under CC BY 4.0. The official image-attribution CSV lists all 3,600 images as CC BY 2.0; preserve attribution and do not redistribute the images.
benchmark_metadata.dataset_integrity_status: verified; all image IDs matched captions and CC BY 2.0 attributions; upstream per-image checksums not published
benchmark_metadata.caption_selection: captions[0], matching the pinned CLIP Benchmark XM3600 loader

official_image_filtering.rule: include an image only when its image file exists

benchmark_metadata.image_id_scheme: XM3600 captions.jsonl source order using image/key
benchmark_metadata.training_data_overlap_risk: The model pretraining corpus is not independently verified to exclude this evaluation dataset; training-data contamination cannot be ruled out.
